name: draft-pre
description: The PRE-DRAFT twin of the `draft` profile: same 12-team SF TEP league and same 4-round snake, but status pre_draft, ZERO picks made, order already assigned. It exists because the mock draft is unreachable on every other profile — DraftRoomScreen refuses with mock-entry.blocked.live whenever board.state === 'live' (a mock snapshots its pool at creation and INV-10 forbids any later platform read, so one started mid-draft would keep offering players the league already took). `draft` is status drafting and `espn` derives live from recorded picks, so both block; only an upcoming board leaves mock-entry.start tappable. draft_order stays populated so the mock resolves a REAL order (order_source platform, not the randomized shuffle) — which is also the pre_draft state the seeder allows draft_order:false against, if the order-unknown board is ever wanted too. The undrafted list is the full 56-player rookie class: nothing is drafted, so no rookie is on a roster.
